title: New fast matrix multiplication schemes
description: Bilinear matrix multiplication schemes with coefficients in {-1, 0, 1}. Below the best known rank in any ring: 11x13x15 with 1364, 11x14x14 with 1373. First ternary scheme at the best known rank: 7x7x9 with 315. 22 further ternary records. Every file satisfies the Brent equations exactly; verify.py checks them with exact rational arithmetic.
